scope: Historical observational audit. All original test await and assertion text retained; no production timing or test oracle changed. Source rows, case executions, timer registrations, callbacks and completed spans are distinct units. Nested spans, helper calls and repeated source/project records overlap. Observed durations do not establish minimum windows or equivalence.
resources: GNU time runs inside serialized benchmark lock and explicit offline harness; queue and namespace setup excluded. Uncontrolled shared-host load remains.
observationPoints: afterAll snapshots can precede later teardown/callbacks; ordinary process-exit hooks can precede later exit listeners. Zero means zero by that snapshot. Actual original clear/fire events are recorded where observed, not inferred from command success.
guards: Docker --network=none --ipc=host, ordinary uid/gid, pinned image/font cache, original browser projects and workspace lease. All three pointer projects retained. Native Node/Chromium channels are isolated by Docker rather than attributed to Bun preload.
